name: A wall component for mobile
description:
1. Explored the codx-junior project structure and store modules (`$chats`, `$projects.kanban`, `$session.events`, `$ui.notifications`, `$teams`) to inventory available data like chats, meets, and Kanban changes.
2. Found a gap: `session.js` calls `$storex.meets.handleMeetEvent(...)` but no `meets` module is registered in `src/store/index.js`, so meet events currently throw.
3. Designed an X (Twitter)-style dark activity wall with a three-column shell, post action bar (reply/repost/like/views/bookmark/share), kind filters, and full design tokens matching X's palette.
4. Delivered `wall.html` — a single-file, browser-runnable mockup with a `mockFetch` interception layer, seeded posts (chat/kanban/commit/pr/meet/index/wiki/system/user), and loading/empty/error states.
5. Documented the mock API contract, what's mocked, try-it paths, accessibility checklist, and a mapping table for wiring the UI to the real stores.

messages.content:
I'll start by exploring the project structure and store modules to understand what data is available, then design a functional mockup cloning X (Twitter)'s home timeline UI/UX.Let me read the full store files and key components to understand the complete data model available.Let me examine the existing wall components and the ChatPreview to understand the current wall implementation, plus check for any template files.I now have a complete picture of the data available. Let me probe two final things — the `meets` reference gap and any existing `templates/` — before I build.I have everything I need. Here's my read on the data landscape: **Data available across store modules (verified):** - `$chats.allChats` → `{id, name, mode, board, column, status(todo/doing/onhold/done/rejected), messages[], updated_at, project_id, tags, profiles, pr_view, file_list}` - `$projects.activeProject` → `project_name, project_icon, metrics.wall` (recent activity), `$state.kanban.boards[title].columns[{title,color,chats[]}]` - `$session.events` → live socket stream `{event, data, ts, project}` (`codx-junior-chat`, `-wiki`, `-online-users`, `-meet`, `-meet-signal`, index progress, notifications) - `$ui.notifications` → `{ts, text, type}` - `$users.onlineUsers` + `$storex.api.userNetwork` → people - `$teams.teams` → teams/channels/members/DMs - ⚠️ **Gap found:** `session.js` calls `$storex.meets.handleMeetEvent(...)` but **no `meets` module is registered** in `store/index.js` — meet events currently throw. The mockup still models meets as a first-class post kind so the UI is ready when that module lands. --- # 🐦 Activity Wall — X (Twitter) clone, powered by codx-junior events ## 1. Direct Recommendation Build a **single-file, browser-runnable mockup** (`wall.html`) that clones the X **Home timeline** three-column shell and re-skins it as a **workspace activity feed**. Every codx-junior event (chat, kanban move, commit, PR, meet, knowledge index, wiki, system, join) becomes a **"post"** with an author, timestamp, context chip, optional rich attachment, and the full **reply / repost / like / views / bookmark / share** action bar. Data flows through a **mock `mockServer`** that mirrors the real store shapes, so swapping to live APIs is a drop-in change. --- ## 2. Screen / Flow Outline **Single screen, multi-route shell (hash-routed, refresh-safe):** | Route | Content | |---|---| | `#/home` | Tabs *For you / Following*, composer, kind-filter chips, timeline | | `#/explore` | Global search results + trends | | `#/notifications` | Grouped likes / reposts / follows / mentions / system | | `#/messages` | Team channels + DMs list (unread badges) | | `#/bookmarks` | Posts the viewer bookmarked (persisted) | | `#/profile` | Profile header + authored posts | | **Thread modal** | Post detail + replies + inline reply composer | | **Compose modal** | X-style full composer (opened from sidebar **Post** button) | **Interactions that must work:** nav switching, tab switch, kind filter, search, compose (validation + counter + loading), like/repost/bookmark toggles (optimistic + persisted), reply → thread, share (copies link), follow toggle, trend → search, dev toggles (error/empty/live-event), reset mock. --- ## 3. Mock API Contract | Method | Endpoint | Payload / Response | |---|---|---| | `GET` | `/api/timeline?tab=&kind=&q=&_fail=` | `Post[]` (sorted desc) | | `GET` | `/api/post/:id` | `{ post: Post, replies: Post[] }` | | `POST` | `/api/posts` | `{ text, replyTo? }` → `Post` (201) | | `POST` | `/api/posts/:id/like\|repost\|bookmark` | `{ on }` → `{ ok, id, action }` | | `GET` | `/api/trends` | `Trend[]` | | `GET` | `/api/suggestions` | `Account[]` | | `GET` | `/api/notifications` | `Notification[]` | | `GET` | `/api/conversations` | `Conversation[]` | **`Post` shape** (mirrors `$chats.allChats` fields): ```jsonc { "id": "p_1", "kind": "chat|kanban|commit|pr|meet|index|wiki|system|user", "authorId": "u_ada", "createdAt": "ISO", "text": "…", "replyTo": null, "context": { "label": "Sprint 24 · codx-junior", "icon": "board" }, "attachment": { "type": "code|board|commits|pr|meet|progress", "…": "…" }, "counts": { "replies": 2, "reposts": 4, "likes": 18, "views": 1240 } } ``` --- ## 4. Design specifications (look & feel — X-accurate dark) | Token | Value | Applied to | |---|---|---| | Canvas | `#000000` | App background (X pure-black) | | Surface | `#16181c` / hover `#1d1f23` | Cards, rail modules, hover rows | | Border | `#2f3336` | All dividers | | Text | `#e7e9ea` / dim `#71767b` | Body / meta | | Accent | `#1d9bf0` | CTAs, focus ring, links, verified | | Like | `#f91880` · Repost `#00ba7c` · Error `#f4212e` | Semantic actions | | Columns | `88px → 275px` rail · `max-w-600px` feed · `350px` rail | X grid, `max-w-[1265px]` centered | | Type | system-ui, **19px** composer, **15px** body, **13px** meta | X scale | | Radii | `rounded-full` buttons/pills · `rounded-2xl` media cards | X shapes | | Motion | `150ms` micro · pulse for LIVE · `prefers-reduced-motion` off | Feedback | --- ## 5. The mockup `wall.html` — open directly in a browser, no server, no build. @@ CODX_FILE @@ path: wall.html language: html change_type: new encoding: text @@ CODX_CONTENT @@ Mockup — Activity Wall (X-style) · codx-junior Skip to timeline

Mockup ·

@@ CODX_END @@ --- ## 6. What's mocked | Area | Simulated | Notes | |---|---|---| | **Transport** | `mockFetch()` intercepts every call; 90–310 ms latency; `?_fail=1` → HTTP 500 | Single swap point for real APIs | | **Data** | 11 seeded posts + 3 replies, 6 accounts (users + bot + projects), trends, suggestions, notifications, conversations | Shapes mirror `$chats.allChats`, `recentChats`, kanban boards | | **Event kinds** | `chat · kanban · commit · pr · meet · index · wiki · system · user` | Each maps to a real socket event family | | **States** | `loading` (skeletons) · `empty` · `error` (retry) — all reachable via right-rail **Dev tools** | | | **Persistence** | `localStorage['mock.codxj.wall.v1']` → viewer flags, created posts, follows | Survives reload; **Reset mock data** clears it | | **Auth** | Seeded viewer "Brian / @gbrian" | No real login | | **Decorative (disabled + commented)** | Composer media/GIF/poll/schedule buttons | Marked `MOCK:` in source | | **Icons** | Inline SVG sprite — zero external assets | Layout survives CDN failure | ## 7. Try it 1. **Like / repost / bookmark** any post → counts update instantly (pink/green/blue), refresh → flags persist. 2. **Post** something in the inline composer (type → counter + enable), or hit the sidebar **Post** for the full modal. 3. **Reply** to a post → thread opens with the post + replies + a reply composer → send a reply. 4. Switch **For you / Following**, then **filter by kind** (Kanban, Meets, Knowledge…). 5. Open **Explore** → search "ada" or click a trend → results filter live. 6. Right rail **Dev tools → Error** (feed 500 + retry) → **Empty** → **↑ Live event** (new event flies to top). ## 8. Run note > **Open `wall.html` directly in a browser — no server, no build, no install.** (A static server is optional as a single file, everything is inline.) --- ## 9.
